mentions.name: ERP business engine backend
mentions.description: This project rebuilds an ERP-like system into a proper ERP backend conceived as a "business engine" that covers most business scenarios, with multi-company, branch, and currency support. It models currency and unit of measure as full core types and traces everything related to business transactions from production to beyond the sale. A persistent workflow engine (like Temporal) is being considered, and an MVP UI is being built to validate the core; whether to open source it is still under debate.
mentions.source_excerpt: Rebuilding my long ERP-like project to become more like a "business engine" to become a proper ERP backend (so it can cover most business scenarios and is multi-company, branch, currency, etc).
